properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 6 at 6:02PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 602 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 8
miles north of Campo, or 13 miles south of Springfield, moving
southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Campo.
